resources.string: Connect an OBD adapter and run a scan to read the MIL status.
Run a scan to read the MIL status and fault codes.
Scanning requires a connected OBD-II adapter. Fault codes are never shown from demo data.
Detected in the current or last drive cycle (Mode 07)
Cannot be cleared by a scan tool (Mode 0A, if supported)
Live checks from validated sensor data
Every scan is saved here so you can compare sessions over time.
Standard OBD-II gives access to emissions-related powertrain data. ABS, airbag, transmission and body control modules usually use manufacturer protocols and are not diagnosed by this app.
Run a fault scan while connected to the vehicle to calculate the score. It is never estimated from missing or simulated data.

The score starts at 100 and is calculated from your latest complete fault scan. Deductions: check-engine lamp on −30; each stored code −10 (max −40); each pending code −5 (max −15); each permanent code −5 (max −10); a critical-severity code −20; each incomplete readiness monitor −3 (max −12). With fresh live data from the ECU: coolant above 105 °C −15; battery voltage outside the normal range −10. Items the ECU does not report are excluded, never assumed healthy. Every deduction is listed above.
Live checks use generic engine guidelines, not JAC factory specifications. A normal reading does not replace a professional inspection.
Last scan %1$s · ECU reports %2$d confirmed code(s)
Some lists could not be read because of communication errors. Scan again before drawing conclusions.
Incomplete monitors are normal right after codes were cleared or the battery was disconnected; they complete after several drive cycles.
Scan complete and saved to history.
Codes cleared. A new scan was saved — codes that return indicate an unresolved fault.
Engine is running. Switch the engine off (ignition ON) before clearing codes.
The ECU refused the request (%1$s). Most ECUs only clear codes with the engine off.
This removes the session from your history. It does not affect the vehicle.
No earlier scan to compare with.
Clearing does NOT repair anything. The underlying fault is still there.
If the fault persists, the code and the check-engine lamp will come back.
All emissions readiness monitors reset to incomplete; a vehicle inspection may fail until several drive cycles are completed.
Freeze-frame data that helps a mechanic diagnose the fault will be erased.
Engine must be OFF with the ignition ON. Permanent codes cannot be cleared.
This code has not appeared in any of your scans.
Descriptions follow the generic SAE J2012 definitions. JAC may define additional conditions; confirm with a JAC service centre before replacing parts.
Only the code structure could be interpreted. JAC DRIVE does not guess causes for codes it does not know.
Stop driving as soon as it is safe and have the vehicle inspected. Continuing may damage the engine.
Have the vehicle inspected soon. Avoid hard acceleration and long trips until repaired.
Schedule an inspection. Usually safe to drive, but efficiency or emissions may be affected.
Minor or emissions-related. Check at your next service.
Severity unknown for this code. Treat it with caution and have it checked.
No issues found in the reported data.
Live sensor checks were not included (no fresh vehicle data).
